items.title: A proof of the cycle double cover conjecture by OpenAI: An exposition
items.abstract: The cycle double cover conjecture states that every bridgeless graph has a list of cycles such that every edge is in exactly two of them. In July 2026, OpenAI announced a proof. This exposition presents the proof with slight modifications and fills in details so the argument can be checked.

items.title: Chromatic polynomials of planar graphs: a survey
items.abstract: We survey chromatic polynomials of planar graphs, their evaluation at roots of unity, and complexity results for computing the Tutte polynomial on graphs of bounded treewidth.

items.title: Partial results and open cases for cycle covers of bridgeless graphs
items.abstract: We survey partial results and list the cases that remain open. We do not prove the cycle double cover conjecture; we only describe equivalent formulations and computational evidence for small graphs.
